decisions.rationale: Old twisted oak: a short, thick, leaning bole on buttress roots with wide, wandering limbs and a few dead leaves; 2 variants 10.0-12.0 m tall; at most 2,574 triangles near, 469 in the middle level of detail and a 6-triangle impostor; 417,792 bytes before meshopt. Parts, triangle budget and impostor checked by the world-assets suite; baked AO.
limitations: Its bark is the pine layer; there is no oak bark.

decisions.rationale: In the dark forests and the Heartlands and Crownlands woods, and alone in open country, at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at natural scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss (trees are not scaled up), with shadows on the ground. Distance bands: near parts to 24 m (spruce, birch and oaks have a middle level there), the middle level to 58 m and impostors to 235 m; the canopy cutaway cone (3-6 m at the hero, twice that at the camera) keeps the hero visible inside the forest.
limitations: Card foliage reads flat and dark where a tree stands beside the camera at mid-distance; the sightline cone keeps the hero and the ground round them clear.
